d:
Suji momo rol resipi bina maida, bina momo shep ke jhanjhat ke!
Sooji Momo Roll Recipe: sabziyon se bhara steamed nashta, jo bachche har hafte maangenge. Poonam Devnani ke saath Masala Kitchen par.
bina maida, suji-aate ki patli roti se momo rol
patta gobhi, gajar, shimla mirch ki chatapti philing
stimar ke pani se momo vali tamatar sos
stim, grevi, eyar phrayar ya shailo phraee, 4 tarike
Comment karein, aap ye nashta kab banayenge aur bachchon ko kaunsi sabzi sabse zyada pasand hai?
